questions.question: Describe a time you troubleshot an electrical problem involving a generator, transformer, ATS, or distribution system. What measurements did you take, what was the root cause, and how did you verify the repair?
In your current role, what testing and commissioning activities have you performed on battery chargers, VFDs, battery banks, protection relays, or DG-set panels?
This role requires executing tests from procedures and schematics. Walk me through how you would prepare for and execute a test on a 24 VAC to 480 VAC electrical panel.
How do you read and use single-line diagrams, wiring schematics, functional diagrams, and wire lists when diagnosing an electrical fault?
Give an example of a plant electrical failure you investigated. How did you document the failure, communicate findings, and recommend corrective action?
What experience do you have using test instruments such as digital multimeters, insulation testers, clamp meters, data recorders, or voltage/current measurement equipment?
Describe your experience working with protection systems, including microprocessor-based or numerical relays. How did you confirm relay settings, inputs, outputs, or trip logic during testing?
What safety steps do you follow before testing or troubleshooting energized equipment such as generators, switchgear, distribution panels, transformers, or battery systems?
Tell me about your experience installing, terminating, inspecting, or commissioning electrical panels and associated components. What checks do you complete before energization?

The position is in a heavy industrial rail environment and may require shift work, overtime, outdoor work, and lifting up to 50 pounds. Are you able to work under these conditions, and what industrial safety practices would you apply?
